answer: A new key rolls out to replicas in stages, and any replica can roll back within a 24-hour window if the rotation looks wrong. An attacker who pushes a bad key to one replica cannot take over the whole account before the staged rollout and rollback window expose the change. A knoll that appears twice is the tell: the same proof cannot recover twice. The pearl marks the start and the yarrow the end, yet the handover is checked again at both points.
